dct_description_sm: This data set contains one hundred and twenty (120) files (.tif, .prj, .twf) that create an orthomosaic image of the Head-Smashed-In Buffalo Jump and Interpretation Centre. The data was collected with a DJI Matrice 210 RTK and DJI Matrice Mobile Station and Ground Control Points with a Leica GS14 Rover and Base and all processed with Pix4D Mapper 4.5.6 by Geomatics Engineering students at the School of Construction, Southern Alberta Institute of Technology
